entry.title: Five brand new ways to use Claude at work

media:group.media:title: Five brand new ways to use Claude at work
media:group.media:description:
Claude's family of tools helps teams work at the speed of thought.
Add Claude to your call with Claude Meetings, and ask it out loud to start a board in Claude Whiteboards while it takes notes. Afterward, ask for a spreadsheet in Claude Sheets or a dashboard in Claude Data. With interactive connectors, you work in the apps you already use without leaving Claude.
Interactive connectors are rolling out on all plans. Claude Data, Claude Whiteboards, and Claude Sheets are available on all paid plans, with Whiteboards and Sheets in beta. Claude Meetings is rolling out in beta on Team and Enterprise plans.
Learn more about each tool at claude.com/resources

entry.title: How Expedia Group builds with Claude managed agents

media:group.media:title: How Expedia Group builds with Claude managed agents
Introducing Claude Meetings
media:group.media:description:
Introducing Claude Meetings: add Claude to your team's video call and it builds docs, whiteboards, and other artifacts with you while you're still talking.
Claude joins as a visible participant. Ask it a question out loud or in chat, or have it start a doc. Your team can see what it's building and correct it as it takes shape.
Claude takes the notes, too. After the call, the notes, action items, transcript, and anything Claude built are on the meeting's page in Claude.
Claude Meetings is starting to roll out in beta on Team and Enterprise plans, starting with Google Meet, with support for other video conferencing platforms coming soon.
Learn more here: https://claude.com/resources/articles/claude-meetings

entry.title: Building the Claude API for the frontier

media:group.media:title: Building the Claude API for the frontier
media:group.media:description:
Every Claude launch puts the spotlight on the model, but just as much work goes into making sure the API evolves with it. That means adding new controls, retiring outdated ones, and helping developers rethink how they build with each new release.
Jake Dejno (Member of Technical Staff, Claude Platform) and Lucca Siaudzionis (Member of Technical Staff, Platform Intelligence) discuss how research and customer requests shape what ships, best practices for changing effort mid-conversation without breaking prompt caching, and how Mythos and Fable use the same model weights with different safeguards.**

Learn more about the Claude Platform: https://claude.com/platform/api
Follow ClaudeDevs on X for product updates and best practices from the Claude Platform team: https://x.com/ClaudeDevs *Claude Managed Agents and changing effort mid-conversation are in beta. **Claude Mythos access is through the Cyber Verification Program.

entry.title: Mariko Mori's world of radiant light

media:group.media:title: Mariko Mori's world of radiant light
media:group.media:description:
Mariko Mori’s exploration of technology as a means of creative expression has pushed the boundaries of art for more than three decades. For her retrospective exhibition Mariko Mori: All That Shines, she used Claude to write code for a computer-generated animation, which was presented as a new video installation. On a seven-meter-wide screen in the final gallery, a horizon parts and opens onto a world of radiant light.
Filmed in Miyakojima and Roppongi, Japan

entry.title: Introducing Claude Whiteboards, Sheets, and Data

media:group.media:title: Introducing Claude Whiteboards, Sheets, and Data
media:group.media:description:
Claude Whiteboards and Claude Sheets are in beta, and Claude Dashboards is now generally available as Claude Data. Brainstorm on whiteboards, build sheets, and share data directly in Claude, with your team working alongside you.
Claude Whiteboards: Talk through a messy plan out loud, and Claude turns it into a board with a timeline, owners, and dates that your team can work on in real time. Drag a box around any part of the board to ask Claude about it.
Claude Sheets: Ask for a campaign tracker or a hiring budget, and Claude builds a spreadsheet with tabs, formulas, formatting, and drop-downs, outlining each edit so you can track changes. Share it, and you, your team, and Claude work on it together.
Claude Data: Your data team certifies the queries everyone should use, and Claude helps you draft data stories or narrated videos from your metrics. With live sharing, colleagues see up-to-date numbers when they open a shared dashboard.
Read the announcement: https://claude.com/resources/articles/sheets-whiteboards-data

media:group.media:title: Meet Claude Fable 5.2
media:group.media:description:
Fable 5.2 is designed to tackle the most daunting technical challenges. It’s a capable collaborator on ambitious projects in many different fields, and shows improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision.
Fable 5.2 is best for the most ambitious, open-ended technical work. For most coding and knowledge tasks, we recommend starting with Opus 5.5.
Available today on Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans.
Learn more: https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-2

entry.title: Claude Fable 5.2 designs a working voice-assistant hub

media:group.media:title: Claude Fable 5.2 designs a working voice-assistant hub
media:group.media:description:
Claude Fable 5.2 designed this voice-assistant hub from a one-paragraph prompt. It laid out the circuit board, modeled the case in CAD and wrote the firmware. Diode Computers then built the board straight from Claude’s design files. It’s an early prototype, one of three devices Claude designed for the project.
Anthropic has a commercial relationship with Diode.
Learn more: https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-2

entry.title: Claude Mythos 5.2 predicts the structure of a therapy capsid

media:group.media:title: Claude Mythos 5.2 predicts the structure of a therapy capsid
media:group.media:description:
Claude Mythos 5.2 predicted the structure of a whole AAV capsid, the protein shell used to deliver gene therapies. The capsid is 60 copies of one protein chain. Claude wrote code that runs open-source folding models on overlapping groups of five neighboring chains, then uses the capsid’s symmetry to stitch all 60 together. On AAV2, its prediction landed within about the width of an atom of the experimental structure.
Learn more: https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-2

media:group.media:title: How Salesforce uses Claude Code
media:group.media:description:
Salesforce scaled Claude Code to thousands of engineers and doubled effective output, with fewer bugs per line of code than before.
Engineering leaders from Salesforce explain how they measure AI coding ROI with an "effective output" score built with Stanford researchers, and how an agent maturity curve moved engineers from simple prompts to autonomous agents across the software development life cycle. They also cover a decades-old codebase made headless in weeks instead of a year, a marketplace for sharing agent skills, incident agents that find the right team automatically, and a bug that Claude Opus tracked down in 24 hours after human attempts failed.
More here: https://claude.com/office-hours#salesforce
